description:
We are a creative team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project focuses on bringing the stories of NASA's abandoned and forgotten space equipment on the Moon and Mars to life through visual storytelling.

Our approach combines research, graphic design, AI-assisted visuals, video storytelling, and educational content to make space exploration history engaging and easy to understand.
summary:
THE FORGOTTEN EXPLORERS is an educational presentation and video documentary based on the challenge “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.”

Our project explores four selected machines: two from the Moon and two from Mars. We explain why they were sent, how they worked, their scientific contributions, the challenges they faced, and what happened to them after their missions.

Our main purpose is to remind people that much of what humanity knows about space today is possible because of machines developed through years of research, hard work, and dedication by countless scientists and engineers.

Today, everyone looks towards future space exploration, but understanding the past is equally important. Earlier missions achieved remarkable results with limited technology and faced challenges that helped shape modern space science.

These machines may no longer be operating, but their contributions are not forgotten. By studying their technology, achievements, and limitations, future generations can learn from past experiences and develop better machines for exploring space.

Our message is simple: Never forget the machines that helped humanity discover the unknown, or the people whose hard work made it possible.
details:
Our project, THE FORGOTTEN EXPLORERS, is an educational multimedia presentation and video documentary featuring four selected NASA space exploration machines: two from the Moon and two from Mars.

We developed this project through research, storytelling, visual selection, presentation design, and video editing. For each machine, we focused on its purpose, technology, mission journey, scientific contributions, challenges, and final status. Our aim was to make complex space exploration history easier to understand through visual storytelling.

Our team consists of two members, Aditya Thakur and Raj Rathore, and both of us worked together to develop this project. Aditya, the team leader, mainly handled video editing, documentary creation, presentation development, and creative direction. Raj Rathore contributed by researching and finding relevant NASA images, original mission footage, and other useful visual resources for the documentary.

We used Canva for presentation design, YouTube as a platform to research and locate relevant video resources, and Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing. We also used NASA's publicly available data, images, and original mission footage, along with AI-assisted tools for voice generation.

Our creative approach was to present the information in a documentary style rather than using lengthy text or unnecessary animations. We carefully selected and edited visuals to make the presentation informative, engaging, and educational.
